The content is everything in `tmc_learn.html` that is not code: the selection and grouping of the card sets, the ligand library with its classes, the notes and explanations, the Name it families, and the structure drawings.

You may share and adapt it for any purpose, including commercially, as long as you give credit. When you reuse it, for example in course slides, a worksheet or another quiz, please write:

> TMC Learn by Francesco Sala (ChemTrain), https://github.com/ChemTrain/tmc-learn, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

and say if you changed anything.

The electron counts follow standard textbook conventions (Crabtree; Hartwig; Green and Parkin, J. Chem. Educ. 2014); please cite those sources as well when you rely on them.

The ChemTrain logo (`logo.svg`, also drawn in the page header and footer) adapts the steam locomotive from [Twemoji](https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji), © Twitter, Inc and other contributors, licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the benzene-ring smoke was added for ChemTrain. If you reuse the logo, credit Twemoji as well.
